summary.business_type: Hospitality — budget hostel (local + international travelers), Varanasi, India
top_findings: api/lib/*.php (incl. credentials file config.php) is directly web-executable, not blocked by robots.txt
/blog/index.html renders empty to non-JS AI crawlers, hiding all 15 posts from GPTBot/ClaudeBot/PerplexityBot
Sitewide advertised pricing (₹499/₹1500) is stale vs live booking-engine rates (₹549/₹2599), wrong in llms.txt, FAQ schema, meta descriptions
Razorpay fraud-detection script silently fails to load on every checkout (CSP missing cdn.razorpay.com)
Google review CTA opens Maps listing instead of the review composer, throttling review velocity
quick_wins: Fix openGoogleReview() deep link in components/site.js
Bump /book-now sitemap lastmod to real last-rebuild date
Add poster + preload=metadata to homepage hero video
Rewrite FAQPage answers to brand-anchor with Mosaic Hostel

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: robots.txt and sitemap.xml both valid
All 21 canonicals self-referencing and correct
bare->www, .html->clean-URL, trailing-slash redirects single-hop
Full security-header set present on HTML and /api/*
Cache-bust versions consistent site-wide post-redeploy
Non-SPA rendering confirmed, structured data valid

findings.title: /api/lib/*.php directly web-executable, not blocked
findings.description: config.php (credentials defines) and other lib PHP files return HTTP 200 directly with no server-side deny; robots.txt has no Disallow: /api/.
findings.recommendation: Add RewriteRule ^api/lib/ - [F,L] to .htaccess and Disallow: /api/ to robots.txt.

findings.title: Homepage hero video has no poster/preload hint
findings.description: 1MB hero-video.webm autoplays with no poster image and no preload=metadata, real mobile LCP risk.
findings.recommendation: Add a poster attribute and preload=metadata.

findings.title: Two legacy blog redirects resolve in 2 hops
findings.description: Old blog slugs land on the non-trailing-slash URL first, then redirect again to the final slug.
findings.recommendation: Point the legacy rules straight at the final trailing-slash URL.

findings.title: No IndexNow implementation
findings.description: No IndexNow ping anywhere in the codebase, worth adding given today's redeploy and ongoing content changes.
findings.recommendation: Implement IndexNow ping on deploy for changed URLs.

findings.title: Header logo lazy-loaded despite being above the fold
findings.description: img loading=lazy on the header logo on every page.
findings.recommendation: Remove loading=lazy from the header logo.

findings.title: /api/availability.php 400 responses cache publicly 24h
findings.description: Error responses are cached publicly for 24 hours.
findings.recommendation: Set Cache-Control: no-store on error responses.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: No spam-thin or duplicate content, zero exact-duplicate paragraphs across 15 posts
Every sampled post has a direct-answer opener and genuine local detail
about.html carries genuine unique narrative, not boilerplate
contact/gallery pages appropriately light with strong trust signals

findings.title: /blog/index.html functionally empty to non-JS crawlers
findings.description: All 15 post cards injected via container.innerHTML = blogsHtml; static HTML is a 20-word H1 only. Blocks AI-engine discovery of the entire blog. Open 3 audit passes running.
findings.recommendation: Server-render the post list as static HTML cards, progressively enhance with JS.

findings.title: 13 of 15 blog posts under depth floor for their intent
findings.description: Posts run 589-1,898 words; competitor guides in this niche typically run 1,500-2,500 words for comparison/itinerary intent.
findings.recommendation: Prioritize expanding the 4 shortest posts first.

findings.title: FAQ answers rarely brand-anchor
findings.description: Only 1 of 5-6 answers per FAQPage block names Mosaic explicitly.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite answers to open with Mosaic Hostel for AI-answer attribution.

findings.title: best-hostels-in-varanasi has stale dateModified
findings.description: dateModified: 2026-04-07 despite being positioned as the current 2026 comparison guide.
findings.recommendation: Update dateModified to match actual last content review.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: All 39 JSON-LD blocks across 24 files parse clean, zero errors
hasMap and FAQPage (added Aug 15) verified valid and present
aggregateRating confirmed still fully absent, compliance fix holds
Hostel/LodgingBusiness blocks complete on all 8 pages

findings.title: @id not unified across pages
findings.description: index.html and book-now.html mint different @id values for the same business entity; 6 other pages have none.
findings.recommendation: Standardize on https://www.mosaichostels.com/#hostel everywhere.

findings.title: No Offer/makesOffer schema on /book-now
findings.description: Live Razorpay+eZee booking engine has no corresponding Offer schema.
findings.recommendation: Add makesOffer using corrected, accurate pricing (fix pricing issue first).

findings.title: blog/post.html template breadcrumb and publisher-image bugs
findings.description: Breadcrumb uses @id instead of item; publisher.logo/image points at a room photo instead of the brand logo.
findings.recommendation: Fix template breadcrumb structure and publisher image reference.

findings.title: No BreadcrumbList on individual blog posts
findings.description: 15 blog posts have no BreadcrumbList schema.
findings.recommendation: Add BreadcrumbList template to blog post pages.

categories.name: Sitemap
what_works: XML structure valid, 22 URLs, zero redirects, all 200
Canonical www host used consistently
No orphan pages, no extras beyond live inventory

findings.title: /book-now lastmod 15+ days stale
findings.description: Page had two substantive rebuilds (multi-room cart, booking fixes) already live but sitemap lastmod wasn't bumped.
findings.recommendation: Update lastmod to match real last-deploy date.

findings.title: /privacy lastmod missed a real NAP fix
findings.description: Postal code correction shipped but lastmod wasn't bumped, inconsistent with sibling pages bumped in the same commit.
findings.recommendation: Bump lastmod for /privacy to match the actual fix date.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness (GEO / AEO / AIO / LLMO)
what_works: robots.txt fully open to GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, OAI-SearchBot
llms.txt present at root
FAQPage schema present on 4 pages

findings.title: Sitewide pricing stale vs live booking engine
findings.description: llms.txt, FAQ schema, meta descriptions, about.html, 4 blog posts, and Hostel.priceRange all advertise ₹499/₹1500; live availability API shows ₹549/₹2599 (private off by ~73%). Likely source: api/lib/mock.php stale fixture values.
findings.recommendation: Correct pricing sitewide from the live API, not hardcoded fixtures; re-derive priceRange schema.

findings.title: /blog/ hub invisible to non-JS AI crawlers
findings.description: Confirmed via curl -A GPTBot: raw HTML has zero post links, all injected client-side. Open 4 consecutive audit passes.
findings.recommendation: Server-render post list as static HTML.

findings.title: FAQPage answers don't brand-anchor
findings.description: Only 1 of 5-6 answers per block names Mosaic explicitly, weakening AI-answer attribution.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite to open every answer with the brand name.

findings.title: No off-site authority signals
findings.description: No YouTube, Reddit, Wikipedia, or LinkedIn presence detected, unchanged from prior passes.
findings.recommendation: Build minimal off-site presence on at least one high-trust platform.

categories.name: Local SEO
what_works: NAP consistent across index/about/contact/gallery/blog/book-now and footer
GBP CID cross-verified mathematically against the Maps embed place-ID
Zero aggregateRating/reviewCount anywhere, compliance intact

findings.title: Google review CTA doesn't open review composer
findings.description: openGoogleReview() in components/site.js links to the plain Maps listing, not a review-write deep link, throttling review velocity.
findings.recommendation: Use the g.page/r/<id>/review short link or search.google.com/local/writereview?placeid=...

findings.title: hasMap schema missing on 3 pages
findings.description: Present on index/about/contact, missing on gallery/blog/book-now.
findings.recommendation: Add hasMap schema to the 3 missing pages.

findings.title: Conflicting airport transfer time claim
findings.description: Homepage FAQ says 15-20 minutes, dedicated transfer-guide blog post says 20-30 minutes for the same trip.
findings.recommendation: Reconcile to one consistent, accurate figure.

categories.name: SXO (Search Experience)
what_works: Booking flow functionally completes end to end
about.html and contact.html carry real trust signals (address, phone, WhatsApp, embedded map)

findings.title: Razorpay CSP bug breaks fraud-detection script
findings.description: .htaccess allowlists checkout.razorpay.com but not cdn.razorpay.com for script-src; confirmed via live console error during rendered checkout.
findings.recommendation: Add cdn.razorpay.com to CSP script-src.

findings.title: Trust badge never reaches /book-now
findings.description: 4.9-star Tripadvisor badge appears on home/about but not on the checkout page where it matters most.
findings.recommendation: Add the trust badge near the /book-now CTA.

findings.title: Comparison content in prose, not table format
findings.description: best-hostels-in-varanasi uses prose H3s; the SERP for its target query is 6/6 comparison tables.
findings.recommendation: Convert the hostel comparison section to a table.

findings.title: Self-cannibalizing OTA logo grid on /book-now
findings.description: "Skip the Commission. Book Direct." sits directly above a grid of 8 OTA logos.
findings.recommendation: Move or remove the OTA logo grid from directly under the direct-booking message.

findings.title: Mobile nav touch targets under 48x48px
findings.description: BOOK NOW button ~103x31px, hamburger ~42x35px, both under the accessibility minimum.
findings.recommendation: Increase touch target sizes to at least 48x48px.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Block /api/lib/*.php from direct web access and robots.txt
Server-render /blog/index.html post list for crawler visibility
Correct sitewide pricing claims to match live booking-engine rates
Fix Google review CTA deep link

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: State competitive edge (proximity to Assi Ghat) on homepage
Convert hostel comparison content to table format

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Expand the 4 shortest blog posts toward the 1,500-2,500 word competitive floor
Remove self-cannibalizing OTA grid placement on /book-now
Fix mobile nav touch target sizes

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Fix blog/post.html template breadcrumb and publisher-image bugs
Reconcile conflicting airport transfer time claim
